'''Yeama''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tassaa Bareesh]] in [[3643 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], he served as a guide to two visitors to Bareesh's palace; [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] [[Eldon Ax]] and [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] envoy [[Ia Nirvin]]. He was killed during the [[Skirmish in Tassaa Bareesh's palace]] by [[Dao Stryver]]'s [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missile]] while manning a [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] firing into [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]] while they purposefully deflected his fire to the same place using [[electromirror shield]]. That way Yeama accidentally assisted them creating an escape route.
